key_decisions.decision: Preserve six/twelve and two-leader/one-leader allocation; render tsab as covered with uncertainty noted rather than inventing a construction design.
Preserve the exclusion and its reason, with the imperfect as required customary carrying; no suggestion that carts were withheld as punishment.

For Nahshon son of Amminadab, retain the one gold kaf and ten-shekel weight; ladle follows the utensil term already used in Exodus, with shape uncertainty noted. Supply shekels from the weight context.
